blocks.text: Kimi K3.1 Pro is a proprietary language model from Moonshot AI, released on Oct 23, 2026.
At $2 input and $10 output per million tokens, it ranks #27 of 40 for input price, placing it mid-range on input cost.
Its context window of 1.0M tokens ranks #26 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
It targets coding, agents, reasoning workloads.
Throughput is measured at 73.5 tokens per second (ranked #16 of 23 for throughput).

Post-trained version of Kimi K3 (2.8T total / 104B active MoE). Always-on thinking with reasoning_effort low/high/max (default max). Text, image and video input. Moonshot says full weights ship by Nov 4 2026; until then it is API-only, so openSource is false. Cyber-related training data is removed from the open-weight release.
